function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m a conversational AI that can help you with a wide range of tasks—everything from answering questions and brainstorming ideas to providing explanations and troubleshooting advice.  
Here’s a quick snapshot of what I can do:

| Category | What I can help with |
|----------|----------------------|
| **General conversation** | Chat about almost any topic, share facts, offer opinions, or just keep you company. |
| **Information & research** | Look up facts, explain concepts, summarize articles, or give you background on a subject. |
| **Planning & organization** | Help draft schedules, create to‑do lists, outline projects, or brainstorm ideas. |
| **Writing & editing** | Draft emails, essays, reports, or creative pieces; proofread and suggest improvements. |
| **Learning & tutoring** | Explain math, science, history, language concepts, or help you study for exams. |
| **Technical support** | Offer guidance on software, hardware, or troubleshooting common tech issues. |
| **Entertainment** | Tell jokes, recommend books/movies, play text‑based games, or create stories. |
| **Smart‑home integration** | (If your environment supports it) I can control devices like an air conditioner. For example, I can set the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position using the `set_ac_state` function. I can also query the current state of the AC with `get_ac_state`. |

If you have a specific task in mind—whether it’s controlling your AC, writing a report, or just chatting—just let me know and I’ll do my best to help!
